question: On CSCS (full precision, vLLM): is the 70B better than the 8B behind the PoesIA engine, and how big is run-to-run noise?
method: evaluate_adapter_mlflow.py --openai-compat --samples 3, seeds 0 and 3 (36 sonnets per language per model), one process per language, through dotfiles/bin/secret-proxy; 8B seed 0 run twice. Pooled = mean over sonnets ± standard error.
reproducibility: 8B seed 0 run twice: 1/18 (es), 3/18 (en), 5/18 (it) sonnets scored identically; per-run totals close (es metre 88.5% vs 88.1%).
correction: Benchmark 1 alone suggested 4-bit lowers metre in all three languages; pooled over 36, Spanish full precision is 84.9% vs 84% at 4-bit (no gap); Italian 90.3% vs 83-85% at 4-bit (gap holds); English 93.3% vs 89-92%.

cost.source: secret-proxy usage log at CSCS academic rates (ui.inference.cscs.ch/pricing, 7 Oct)
